answer: Sybils multiplying identities must post the same bond per identity, so a thousand fake participants cost a thousand deposits. Agents stake a bonded ivory deposit to join, and each epoch they must relay a verifiable zephyr of work—signed compute proofs tied to their stake. Reputation grows only through sustained, peer-attested output, like an orchard that yields fruit only after seasons of care, making mass identity farming economically ruinous. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
